title: Panjaa
overview: Jai, an orphan, falls into bad company after Bhagwan, a gangster, gives him shelter and hope to live. However, Jai and Munna, Bhagwan's son, fight with each other after Munna kills an innocent woman.

title: Finding Happy
overview: At her lowest point, a woman rescues an injured one-day old sparrow, and their profound bond sparks a worldwide journey to explore with other extraordinary human-animal connections, challenging us to see kindness, connection, and compassion, in a whole new light.

title: Across Timing
overview: Rachel, Hadrian, Stormi, and Julian are teenagers dealing with their own insecurities, desires, and fears while finding solace in conversations with a friend who watches them from behind a camera. Between spontaneous confessions and heavy silences, each of them reveals fragments of who they are and who they wish to be. But some truths are hard to face, and not all stories follow the path we imagine.

title: Underground
overview: 2060: In a dystopian future, a lonely mother faces an enormous dilemma when she has to choose between protecting her son, persecuted by an oppressive system, and maintaining her own moral principles.

title: The Potion
overview: A horror film based on the legendary work of Olga Kobylianska "On Sunday Early I Dug a Potion".

title: Para atrapar el viento
overview: A man chases a rebellious gust of wind across the hills as it creates chaos and music through the grassland.

title: Shooting Stars (They Flew in the Firmament, Love)
overview: He escaped that night without knowing that Valeria would be there... Luca had no idea that his life would change forever.

title: I Constantly Thank God for Esteban
overview: Home alone on the eve of her First Communion, 12-year-old Carmen receives an unexpected visit from a trio of neighborhood roller girls and scooter boys. While at her home, the kids make Carmen painfully aware of her religious upbringing, ultimately stealing her First Communion dress, culminating in a final showdown at their local roller rink.

title: Hammer and Nail
overview: Ondřej Blažek, confronts the raw, untold emotions behind the fight. This UFC-inspired documentary takes you deep into the mind of a fighter, where each punch carries the weight of personal sacrifice, triumph, and inner demons. With high-octane energy and cinematic intensity, Coach Ondřej revisits pivotal moments from his career, reflecting on the emotional turmoil and adrenaline that fuel him. Watch as we recreate one of his most defining fights, immersing you in the brutal reality of what it means to fight, not just against your opponent—but against yourself.

title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
overview: The Lick of Death follows Clyde Saxophone in another dastardly case. A new mysterious criminal has emerged and it’s up to Clyde Saxophone to stop them. Does he have what it takes to solve this enigma? Or will he get lost in the sauce?  Laugh, cry, vomit, and piss yourself just a little bit in this breakout classic from award-winning directors Dan Griffiths and Magnus Paulak

title: The Absence of No
overview: A sexual assault allegation at a university forces those involved and the audience to confront how quickly assumptions and appearances can distort our understanding of the truth.

title: Welcome Home
overview: A promotional film about an adventurous summer at Onteora Scout Reservation

title: Jezebels
overview: Emma, an ambitious writer joins her new friend Lucy at a secret, all-female literary society. What begins as a night of radical intellectual freedom quickly reveals a ruthless test, where Emma must decide how much of herself she's willing to sacrifice to get ahead.

title: I Miss My Mom
overview: Francis visits home to care for his mother with Alzheimer’s while his father is away on business. As her condition deteriorates, she grows increasingly convinced the man living in her home is not her son.

title: Session 14
overview: A man denying his grief seeks redemption through a therapist, but when he must relive what he caused will he take responsibility?

title: Farm of the Father
overview: Dorotea is a young farmer who lives in the family's farm with her father. But, the Father reveals himself to be increasingly obsessive. Stranger and more disturbing events keep happening, and Dorotea just wants to run away.
cast: Giovanni Amendola Provenzano Andrea Orso Valerio

title: Happy Place
overview: A bout of lucid dreaming presents a tired student with the ability to vent his built-up frustrations on his friends in increasingly cartoonish ways.

title: still life
overview: This work is based on long-exposure still photographs of everyday scenes taken between 2025 and 2026. While there is no video, the accumulation of light transforms into an intense flicker that seems to break through the retina, compressing the sense of time and inducing hallucinations.

title: Microcosmos 2
overview: This film created using magic lantern slides from about a century ago.

title: Stay
overview: After experiencing several nightmares in which his mother dies, Diego begins to question the truth of his reality. When he realizes that the nightmares are actually memories, Diego must decide whether to stay with his mother in this reality or return to the reality where she no longer exists.

title: Sithilam
overview: A 15 year old lie resurfaces as a YouTuber is suddenly interested in a closed case of serial killings, doubting the testimony of the sole survivor of that murderer.

title: Fugue
overview: An unnamed protagonist is transported inexplicably into a state of purgatory.

title: LEGACY
overview: 🏆 Best Fantasy Short Film Award – Cinefantasy (Brazil)  STARRING: ANNABELLE LENGRONNE (Cannes Competition / Stockholm Best Actress for Léonor Serraille's "Mother and Son") & VINCENT COLOMBE (Coralie Fargeat's "Revenge").  Through a tense confrontation, "LEGACY" is a 7-minute satirical thriller using the codes of genre cinema to dissect class privilege and the enduring legacy of slavery.  Panicked and ragged, a man flees through the forest, hunted by an eighteenth-century aristocrat carrying a rifle. He is white. She is Black.

title: Jacob McLeod: Leelanau
overview: A longing artist reconnects with nature.  A single off Jacob McLeod's "MICHIGAN-20" (2026) album.

title: Pleasant: First Look
overview: A stranded man in a hot dog costume continues his strange night in a open-late store. A proof of concept for the upcoming indie feature "Pleasant".

title: Jared Freid: The Family Plan
overview: The special finds Freid keeping his issues “in the family,” joking about everything from vacationing with his parents to a Karen video that hits close to home.

title: George Street
overview: Cathy and Jessica catch up as they navigate one of Sydney's busiest streets, George Street.

title: ISO: Whore in Law
overview: Two sisters turn the grief over their dying brother into an absurd mission to expose their unfaithful sister-in-law.

title: The Ballad of Being a Better Mother
overview: Every morning, a middle-aged mother prepares breakfast for her family, as part of their daily routine that had never been fulfilled before. Life seems to carry on as normal, but something feels strange beneath the surface of this routine. When the village authorities arrive with a message, the truth that has long been hidden slowly begins to unfold.

title: At The Bottom
overview: A desperate man pays for a risky transcendent experience, leaving his body at risk to an alter-ego.

title: The Otherkind
overview: Chaos seeps into a sleepy mountain lake town, as something sinister comes to the surface.

title: Lotgenoten
overview: After her winning lottery ticket is stolen, bartender Martha locks up her café. No one is allowed inside or outside until she gets her ticket back.

title: Como Dominar o Mundo (ou Meninos Mimados)
overview: While Marcelo and his childhood friends, João Gabriel and João Tadeu, wait to watch the Flamengo game, Marianne, his ex-girlfriend, sends him a voice message saying that her intimate photos have been leaked. Unsure of how to react and prompted by one of the Joãos, Marcelo starts a conversation about whether young people like them could take over the world.

title: In the Sub for Love
overview: She is a tactical submarine officer. He is a steward. Before diving for 90 days she chooses to make it her "four-hour". But here he is clinging. Who follows her. Who sticks it. Where do we go if the flight crew of a 747 prides itself on romance? As if we had time to be in love on board a military ship. Still, the Pacific Ocean is not big enough. Neither does the Arctic Ocean. The world is so small when you love each other so much.

title: The Death of Robin Hood
overview: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

title: The Girl with the Leica
overview: The love story of Gerda Taro and Robert Capa.

title: Hộ Linh Tráng Sĩ: Bí ẩn mộ Vua Đinh
overview: Based on the folklore about the 7 warriors and the mystery of the tomb of Emperor Dinh.

title: No Paradise If You Are Killed by a Woman
overview: A female Kurdish-Norwegian sniper returns to the battlefield she once escaped, driven by vengeance and by the desperate hope of rescuing her younger sister, still imprisoned by ISIS in Mosul.

title: Have you ever thanked God?
overview: Have You Ever Thanked God is a short reflective film that gently reminds us of the blessings we often overlook.  Through calm visuals and heartfelt narration, the film invites the viewer to pause, breathe, and notice the simple miracles hidden in everyday life.

title: The Hunger
overview: Victoria, a seamstress exhausted by hardship, sustains the fragile existence of her brother Lucas, who lives confined to a wheelchair in an environment of extreme poverty. However, prolonged deprivation awakens something dark: a monstrous transformation in Lucas that drives him to devour everything.

title: Everything On Land With Bones Is A Fish
overview: A man appears to be falling from a building, but it's the building behind him that rises, leaving a crater in the ground. Strange structures emerge from the hole and then ascend. When he tries his keys to get back inside, his real fall begins.

title: Unification of Japan 76
overview: Following the death of acting chairman Baba (Akihiko Kuwata), Kyowakai continues its hunt for Adachi (Atsushi Arai), while the Marugami-kai and the Special Investigation Unit closely monitor their movements. As expected by Himuro (Yasukaze Motomiya), Adachi contacts the Keihin Alliance's Sakagami (Yoshiki Kanahashi), prompting the Yamazaki Ichimon to stake out the group's key locations. Adachi attempts to strike a deal with Sunaga (Masataka Naruse) but flees when it falls through, escaping Teru (Yutaka Kyan) and Ryuji (Tatsuya Kishida). Himuro and Tamura (Yoshiyuki Yamaguchi) then change tactics by kidnapping Sunaga. Meanwhile, reports pour in that Yamazaki faction members are attacking the Keihin Alliance's affiliated groups, leaving everyone to wonder what Himuro's true plan is.

title: Saving Cherry
overview: Determined to take back control, Cherry embarks on a wild road trip with her bridesmaids and wedding planner on a mission to lose her virginity, while a remorseful Jude tries to win her back.

title: Blush Red
overview: A short film inspired by Kevin Atwater's album of the same name. Two men meet late one night at a bar on New York's Lower East Side and walk home together, falling in love along the way. Filmed on the streets of NYC.

title: The Last Solution
overview: Within the confines of a massive wall, a group of children plays as if there were no tomorrow

title: Eurokryvbas
overview: 'Eurokryvbas' explores the rise of Ukrainian cities like Dnipro, Kryvyi Rih, and Kamianske, shaped by British, Belgian, Polish, German, and French investors during the 19th-20th centuries. Soviet policy erased their European origins. Today, experts and local activists are working to preserve this heritage amid Russia's ongoing war for these lands.

title: Giaffa The Great
overview: Giacomo Falta is a man ignored by everyone, unable to find his place in the world. When he meets the charismatic Giason the Great, the man who embodies everything he has always wanted to be, he makes a dangerous decision, convinced that putting on a different face is all he needs to do to finally be seen. Thus begins a long night, in which the boundary between identity and illusion grows increasingly blurred, to the point where Giacomo's very existence is put at risk.

title: Pepita the Gunslinger
overview: Mar del Plata, 1985. Pregnant and working as a sex worker, Margarita Di Tullio defies the mafia and a corrupt power structure to build a clandestine empire that shields women from the horrors of the streets, becoming a legend forged by a shotgun and maternal loyalty… the legend of Pepita, the Gunslinger.

title: Against The Skin
overview: In a world driven by inherited beliefs, social noise, and quiet despair, a searching mind wrestles with the question of purpose, challenging whether humanity is truly living or simply surviving until it disappears.

title: Мой папа — медведь 2
overview: A grown-up Masha decides to arrange a personal life for her father, Misha, which leads to a fight with her father, who pries into matters that don't concern her. Masha, upset with her father, runs away into the forest and ends up with a little bear cub whose parents were kidnapped by poachers. Masha's adventures begin, during which she realizes how difficult it is to be a parent, and most importantly, how difficult it is to raise children.

title: Kuzma: Extremely Happy
overview: Through exclusive archival footage and never before seen home video, this documentary aims to explore the real face of Andriy Viktorovych Kuzmenko (Kuzma Skryabin), the father of the contemporary Ukrainian rock and roll scene.

title: Nomina
overview: A woman with no name wakes alone in a forest, where three strangers draw her into a ritual she was never meant to escape.

title: Darkface Files
overview: Following the brutal murder of his friend Kenji by the masked killer "Darkface"—a criminal who leaves a feather on his victims—an anxious and grieving Samuel Rosenberg becomes involved in the investigation led by Detective Vincent Moreau. When a mysterious forgotten note accidentally catches his attention, Samuel decides he cannot simply stand by. His discovery will lead him straight to the cold, damp alleyway where his friend lost his life, plunging him into a lethal face-to-face confrontation with the killer himself.

title: Не по-детски
overview: After a major scandal on air, popular TV host Mark Nikolaev tries to restore his reputation and sets out to find Natasha, an orphanage graduate whose victory on a music show sparks a public conflict. However, his attempt to "fix the situation" unexpectedly changes him, forcing him to confront real life for the first time outside the cameras and social media.

title: Images of Fire
overview: A couple’s conversation unravels a film shaped by memory, where images and sounds reconstruct a past marked by state violence.

title: Girl At The Coffee Shop
overview: A lonely ad designer finds unexpected connection when the enigmatic Nora sits beside him in his favorite corner café. Their tender romance unfolds against the quiet rhythms of daily life—until hidden truths begin to surface.

title: Autopsy: Dead Body Can Talk
overview: Dr. Sumy Hastry—a sharp, calm, and experienced forensic is intertwined with intuition and supernatural phenomena that are part of her long journey.

title: A Fortress
overview: Antu has been living in her occupied school for months, which she and her classmates took over. As her mother’s birthday approaches and rumors of eviction grow, Antu is faced with a choice: she stay in the own world she and her friends have created, or return home?

title: Crux
overview: After the loss of her mother, Margo's life takes an unexpected turn when her estranged older sister reappears in her life. As grief and unresolved family tensions weigh heavily on her, Margo attempts her hardest rock climb yet.

title: A Quiet Man
overview: A man journey's across an apocalyptic world to visit his wife's grave.

title: Falling House
overview: A modest family on the outskirts of Tehran faces the imminent destruction of their home as a part of a vast redevelopment project. While Rashid, the father and a prison guard, is being accused of corruption, he discovers that his eldest daughter, Ensi, is secretly planning to leave Iran to become a model. As the bulldozers draw ever closer, the tensions within the household start to rise.

title: Queer Edward II
overview: Spring 1991: As queer life is under attack in Britain, experimental artist Derek Jarman is turning Edward II into a radical protest film. Told through unseen behind-the-scenes footage, this is a story of the power and cost of queer visibility — then and now.

title: Memories of Lightning
overview: Sibilla, a radio reporter, travels to a small town in central Italy to make an audio documentary. There, in 1982, a young woman had been killed, in an act of apparently inexplicable violence. Through voices and sounds, Sibilla evokes the ghosts of a past event, recording the last reverberations of the victim’s memory.

title: All Goes Wrong
overview: In an almost empty Buenos Aires, without power or gas, a suicidal young man is forced to survive.

title: Separada pero nunca sola
overview: It follows the story of Isabel, played by Emilia Drago, a woman who seeks to restart her life in the jungle.

title: Magey Bituge Wedding
overview: The most chaotic love story ever!

title: A Spoonful of Love
overview: Successful Boston chef Areg travels to Armenia in search of new inspiration and meets Lusin. Love, Armenian cuisine and unexpected revelations force him to choose between returning to his old life or starting over.

title: Timoteo
overview: The plot follows two neighbors who find themselves in a bind when one of their dogs shows up at home with a dead parrot which belongs to another neighbor.

title: Grylu Sker
overview: Grylu Sker is the tale of a lost explorer set in a world of Icelandic folklore written by Tab Murphy (Gorillas in the Mist, The Haunted Swordsman) and Icelandic author Sjón (co-writer of The Northman). It is a story of an explorer's fight for survival on a bleak unforgiving island and also a re-imagining of the legendary Icelandic witch Gryla. This film will utilize 36 inch tall bunraku puppets, stop motion animation, traditional in-camera effects and old-fashioned smoke and mirrors trickery.

title: Oh My Ghost! Oh My God!
overview: A Japanese pop icon returns to her late mother’s birthplace in a mountain village, joined by a former classmate and her boyfriend. Their trek into the forest turns dark after disturbing ancestral spirits. Trapped in thick fog, fear manifests into inner demons as supernatural events unfold, blurring the line between self-discovery and a descent into madness.

title: Hour and Twenty
overview: On Christmas Eve, emotionally distant mother Manuela's six-year-old Iván disappears from a mall. As two Guardia Civil investigators pursue the case, Manuela is driven toward a more unsettling possibility: she may be losing her grip on reality. With no evidence of a kidnapping, the case escalates when authorities uncover her criminal past — and no one claims to remember ever seeing her with a child. As time tightens, Manuela must prove her innocence before it’s too late.

title: A Sunken Place
overview: A young neurologist discovers a cure for depression, only to be opposed by a giant pharmaceutical corporation determined to destroy her.

title: I'm Game
overview: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down.

title: Late Fame
overview: At the very end of the 1970’s, post office worker Ed Saxberger wrote a book of poetry that nobody cared about. After an eager and flattering fan appears on his doorstep, Saxberger is beckoned into a coterie of young admirers who anoint him a rediscovered genius. The group of downtown bohemians is led by their “tragic heroine,” Gloria. Intoxicated by the attention, and Gloria’s alluring presence, Saxberger gradually reckons with the authenticity of his newfound poetic circle.

title: The Basics of Philosophy
overview: A repressed philosophy professor, Dr. John Jorissen, is employed at Ridgemont College, a small liberal arts school in the American Midwest. He teaches an introductory course and is writing a book on renowned Dutch philosopher Baruch Spinoza. Haunted by a long-buried transgression and the sudden return of its victim, he descends into a crisis of guilt, desire, and spiritual reckoning.

title: Mirzapur: The Movie
overview: The battle for Mirzapur’s throne intensifies as old enemies resurface and a new threat emerges in the form of Babban Babua, a ruthless businessman from Jaisalmer with ambitions of his own. As the Tripathis face enemies from both the past and present, loyalties are tested while Guddu and Bablu Pandit fight to establish themselves in the power struggle for Mirzapur.

title: Fractured Bonds
overview: Chaos ensues when 4 siblings reunite for their father’s will reading, creating a rocky divide within the already broken family.

title: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
overview: Small-town Kansas hairdresser Gail Daughtry's fiancé uses his 'celebrity sex pass' on Jennifer Aniston, prompting Gail to travel to LA with her friend Otto to find her own pass, Jon Hamm, to even the score.

title: Furies
overview: During Lebanon’s corruption-fueled economic collapse, the banks freeze millions of depositors out of their own life savings. Maro, a determined single mom, and her wild-hearted sister Dalia begin to scheme a daring, all-night heist to get their own money back.

title: Celtic Utopia
overview: The story of a new Ireland and its vibrant music scene, but also that of a postcolonial society wrestling with its heritage. A society where folk music carries both the oppression of the past and the dream of a bright future.

title: The Incomer
overview: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy survive by hunting seabirds, retelling the stories of their ancestors, and defending the isle from dreaded "Incomers". Their world is upended with the arrival of an awkward council worker who has come to uproot them from their homeland.

title: Me and My Condemned Father
overview: In 2002, Cheng's father murdered his mother. He is both the son of the perpetrator and the beloved son of the victim. That afternoon, he met the children of two other death row inmates. The three of them talked about life, about marriage, and about their greatest fear: their fathers, and the death penalty.

title: Leviticus
overview: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most:  each other.

title: CHAITANYA
overview: The story of Chaitanya, the mystic saint who transformed devotion into a revolution.  The great king Prataparudra learns that God Himself is secretly present in his kingdom. He tries to meet with Him, but he must pass through insurmountable trials to earn His favor.

title: Spiral
overview: While celebrating his engagement, Sean finds out that his future brother-in-law has an unnaturally large penis.

title: Mel
overview: A man recounts a dream to his doctor where he pursues a woman who feels hauntingly familiar.

title: Infrared
overview: Six young people wake up trapped in a bathroom with no memory of how they got there. As the confinement drags on, their guilt, fears, and latent violence surface, while the light reveals what no one wants to face.

title: Morning Afternoon Night
overview: They say you can start over, but if the music in your head is different, and the smells aren’t the same...then what? Where is that start?  In a single day, Marta, a young Russian migrant in Perth faces the end of her visa and the question of who she really is when home is nowhere to be found.

title: Balcanica
overview: Music has been banned in Afghanistan, and now an orchestra conductor and his son, a tuba player, attempt to start over by emigrating along the Balkan route. During their flight, seemingly endless, they cross paths with an Italian woman, a doctor. This encounter will change the two refugees’ lives and that of the young woman as well.

title: Ephemera
overview: In a strange future, a national security agent with pyrotechnic abilities is horribly burned in battle and develops a fear of fire. She returns to action but cannot shake her fear. She undergoes experimental procedures to gain new powers and sets out to get revenge on those who destroyed her life. This film is reminiscent of such science fiction classics as Blade Runner and Ready Player One.

title: She Saw Us
overview: When four friends discover a cursed two-headed doll in a remote forest, they unleash a vengeful witch who traps them in a place from which no one has ever escaped.

title: Landmine
overview: For the first time in a decade, Colette, Johan and Lisa reunite for a winter holiday on the South African coast. Each has built a life elsewhere in an attempt to escape the instability of their childhoods and the long shadow of their mother, Annatjie. The atmosphere changes radically when Colette reveals that she has invited their mother. Annatjie arrives like a storm and pulls the family back into old patterns of resentment, survival mechanisms and unfinished history. Over time, her presence causes the distance they have tried to put between themselves and their past to disappear. Each is forced to ask how much of their lives still revolves around her gravity, and whether that hold can ever truly be broken. Landmine is an intimate chamber drama about inherited trauma, duty and the impossible act of giving up and letting go.

title: Harila - Nådeløse fjell
overview: Kristin Harila and Tenjen Lama Sherpa, two underdogs from Vadsø and Nepal, climb the world's 14 highest mountains in record time. They make history – before encountering massive opposition.

title: Gu Shi
overview: A family of four – Father, Mother, Daughter and Son – arrives at a mysterious house between the ocean and the forest, feeling an unnamed crisis. What begins as a temporary stay stretches into a strange limbo. After an accident leaves Son bedridden, the family turns to a ritual of telling stories about the ocean, stories that seem to make people forget. Haunted by recurring nightmares, Daughter begins to sense that her own missing childhood memories are tied to the house and to a girl in a green dress. As the past surfaces and the boundary between reality and story dissolves, she must choose her way of remembering.

title: Cream Style
overview: A man eats bad creamed corn, makes a bad decision, and suffers for eternity.

title: Body and Mind
overview: Unable to accept her lover's suicide, a woman refuses to believe he is gone. She dismembers his body and insists he was murdered. Yet the world remains haunted by his presence. As she forms a strange communion with his scattered body, fragments of their shared past resurface. Reality, memory, and dreams gradually dissolve into one another, blurring the boundaries between grief and truth.

title: Left Hand Pianist
overview: While pursuing his doctoral studies in the United States, promising pianist Lee Hoon suffers a stroke that paralyzes his right hand. Returning to Korea, he discovers the possibility of performing with his left hand alone and begins rebuilding both his life and identity through music. Supported by his mother and inspired by the joy that first drew him to the piano, he overcomes his limitations and embraces a new path.

title: You Rain Down on Me
overview: In a society where teenagers are required to receive a vaccine against romantic feelings, Ido falls in love with Eunha, a transfer student.

title: Your Personal Taxi
overview: A one-of-a-kind classic taxi carries passengers with seemingly ordinary lives but extraordinary stories, each journey accompanied by a song of their choosing.

title: They Are Not to Blame
overview: A man who dreams of making a superhero film meets a woman upstairs who practices backward breakfalls every day.

title: Bleed
overview: A family in crisis on Halloween night is thrown into turmoil when a long-estranged relative shows up on their doorstep after committing a horrific crime.

title: Act 3
overview: The latest in Christine Molloy and Joe Lawlor’s series of cinematic essays is a rich and thought- provoking journey through aging, legacy and the intersection between artistic and personal relationships. Molloy and Lawlor engage in a witty and moving conversation that explores family history and their latest project, a film about groundbreaking artists Claude Cahun and Marcel Moore. As they analyse this decades-long relationship, they identify parallels between these two artists and their own lives. Act 3 celebrates the power of connection, of artistic exploration and the importance of memory to shape our present and future.

title: Hunger
overview: A woman enters a surreal night of fractured memories where the ghosts of love, art and violence resurface - forcing her to repeat a long-buried crime in order to reclaim her life.

title: Go Get It
overview: When a bizarre glitch throws the orders of a popular five-minute delivery app into chaos, a delivery rider finds himself caught in a chain reaction of increasingly dangerous mix-ups.

title: To Escape
overview: Built from classic prison films, To Escape follows a man’s relentless attempt to break free, turning a jailbreak into a story about the will to keep going.

title: Melody of the Damned
overview: Two siblings accidentally summon a group of musical demons who take over their late grandmother's attic to put on a variety show.

title: Alpha Gang
overview: Alien invaders, in the form of a 1950’s biker gang, are sent on a mission to conquer Earth.

title: What We Saw
overview: A boy has died. On the final day of his brief life, the story traces not only his fading memories but also those of Mujin, the teacher who held him dear.

title: LONDON
overview: London, a disabled young adult working in a fetish house, finds himself caught in an unexpected dilemma when offered the chance to understand his body through a medical exam.

title: Sex, Power & Drugs: Act I
overview: First installment in the franchise.

title: GREEN
overview: A young woman and a young man—lifelong friends—reflect on love through someone else's story, without realizing that love might be closer than they think.

title: Eklipse
overview: Twelve-year-old Tomy spends the summer of the 1999 solar eclipse with his best friend Chris on an alpine pasture. When Chris learns that Tomy's father is in hospital with AIDS, their friendship falls apart – and Tomy suddenly finds himself torn between exclusion and the secrecy of his own family.

title: Tijuana, Todavía
overview: In Playas de Tijuana, a young queer man fleeing Russia to avoid being conscripted in the Ukraine war due to his identity, and a middle-aged gay man navigating Northern Mexican machismo, connect through a gay hookup app where they hide behind digital alter egos. When their relationship moves offline, they come face to face with the wounds inflicted by their respective exiles.

title: BALL PIT
overview: A father haunted by a childhood trauma is forced to confront his worst nightmare when a ball pit appears at his daughter's birthday party.

title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Prelude to a Wedding
overview: When Gethsemane is invited to play at a wedding, she and Eamon find themselves involved in the death of a member of the bridal party.

title: A Bitter End
overview: Mabel, a struggling artist, has reached the age of lost illusions and must face reality. Just after moving in with her boyfriend, she feels an irresistible urge to run away. Returning to the artist squat where she once lived, she weaves an intimate lie to test her loved ones’ reactions and try to reconnect with them.

title: Catching Rat
overview: ₩50,000 per rat. Alone on a night shift, Joohyeong puts his finger on the line.

title: Sunflowers in Sorrow
overview: After many years apart, Sue and Paula, two former wrestlers in their seventies, reunite for one last motorcycle road trip to their childhood home. Unspoken words will eventually burst.

title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 1
overview: The first night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 5, 2026 at Light Cube Utsunomiya in Utsunomiya, Tochigi, Japan.

title: Versailles en fête
overview: During European Heritage Days, France’s most famous castle becomes the setting for a spectacular event where heritage, music, and contemporary art come together in an exceptional setting. From its most iconic locations to spaces that are usually overlooked, the castle is transformed into a living stage.
cast: Orchestre de l’Opéra Royal de Versailles

title: Polski Crash
overview: Early 90's. The political and economic landscape of Poland, Russia and Germany is changing. Both good and bad sides of freedom are revealed. The mafia is becoming more and more bold, operating without obstacles across borders. One of the more lucrative "businesses" is the trade in luxury cars, stolen in Germany and transferred to Russia by Russia.

title: 25 Cats from Qatar
overview: The nation of Qatar has a street cat population equal to the entire human population of the entire country – and is growing fast. Disease is rampant, and local adoption is rare. 25 CATS FROM QATAR follows one mission – led by a network of multinational underground animal rescuers in Doha and a Milwaukee flight attendant/ cat cafe owner – to transport out 25 lucky felines and find homes for them abroad, all the while searching for a long-term solution to the crisis.

title: Go for Gold
overview: A Filipina housekeeper starts her first day working for an injured Filipino-Canadian Track Star. In her attempt to connect with him culturally, secrets from his past in the Philippines unravel.

title: Moonfish
overview: A grieving astronaut who's lost his only companion on a deep-space mining mission must fulfill a strict corporate quota to return home. As his year of solitude passes, his grip on reality unravels the line between the living and non-living.

title: Pizza Paradiso
overview: "Pepe" Vespa is a pizza maker in "La Unión"

title: Ma the Matician
overview: Musician Pi has lost the story he once wanted to convey through his songs. With the core of his creativity gone, he drifts without direction. Heo-su, who loves mathematics, devotes himself to his research while extolling its beauty. He dreams of Paris, a city where mathematics coexists with history and the arts. Recognizing the extraordinary potential of both individuals, Lee harbors an ambitious vision: to build a multidisciplinary cultural and arts collective around them and orchestrate something on a grand scale.

title: Life of Jorge Luis Borges
overview: A biography of Jorge Luis Borges working from an exhaustive review of the papers he left, the books he read, the places he went to. And with this, an attempt to decipher a very peculiar life: someone who lived like a hidden, underground warrior, whose cause was literature, literature conceived as a kingdom and as a landscape. If Cold War spies fought from their desks or from an uninhabited house to defend their half of the world, Borges strove from a library to elevate and broaden the territories of his own tribe: the people for whom the most important part of the universe is books, plots and words. This film is devoted to that secret pilgrim (to borrow from Le Carré, the king of all spies).

title: Friendly Fire & Other Assorted Songs
overview: William JOSÉ unwittingly attracts vultures. Disgusted, he hitches his belongings to a trailer and sets off, but an accident interrupts his escape. Unable to continue his journey, he must confront the beasts pursuing him in a tumultuous and revealing conflict.

title: Гаркуша
overview: Seven years after their first shoot, young director Katya returns to her hero, musician Oleg Garkusha. However, the attempt to make a sequel turns into a frank conversation, where the camera proves to be merely a pretext and a mirror for the real reason for their meeting.

title: Middling
overview: Two class (and soul) mates unravel across time, space, and mediocre diner french fries.

title: Black Lizard / Diamond Impulse
overview: Black Lizard Great detective Kogoro Akechi and the enigmatic female thief Black Lizard. Within their thrilling game of pursuit and evasion, a solitary, unspoken love gradually blossoms between hunter and hunted. Diamond Impulse A shimmering diamond, bursting with the power to awaken countless emotions and impulses in us. This is a sparking stage performance that mixes IMPULSE—ephemeral feelings: the passion and love of those who keep on singing and dancing; desire and envy—with the transparent serenity and seductive scintillation of a diamond.

title: Arrested Memory
overview: Lee is a superstar police detective in Taipei. After losing his team during a crime investigation, he is haunted by guilt and transferred to a rural police station. Traumatized by the incident, Lee develops amnesia—but is determined to keep it a secret. Soon, he is assigned a new case: the kidnapping of the son of an influential Japanese businessman. As his memory continues to fade, Lee can only rely on his instincts—which, against all odds, lead him to the criminals.

title: A Common Story
overview: Erika and Mauro live in the province, living a simple life made up of reassuring habits and small gestures. When their daughter Irene leaves to study abroad, the house empties, and the balance on which the couple has built their existence seems to be shaken.

title: Faux Amis
overview: Adele and May, two American twenty-somethings with different backgrounds and a less than sturdy friendship, travel together to Paris so that Adele can finally unite with the handsome Jacques, an (unbeknownst to the women) reclusive local there who has been courting Adele from across the Atlantic via Instagram. The city is not kind to their relationship.

title: Lomu
overview: A Tongan/Kiwi warrior who could run 100 metres in under 11 seconds. He was the youngest All Black to put on the jersey and still holds the record for the most tries scored in World Cup history.

title: Teka
overview: Left home alone, young Jali wants to cut a papaya but can't find a knife. Instead, he uses Enkong Na'im's sacred machete, ignoring the strict warning that this ancient weapon should never be messed with

title: The Burning Giants
overview: A mysterious smoke covers western Thailand, triggering a strange infectious disease whose symptoms resemble burns inflicted by an invisible fire. A villager from the Karen ethnic group is arrested deep in the jungle and taken to a quarantine centre. There, he dreams of returning to his mountain homeland. His wife, who has sought refuge in Bangkok, shares the same longing. But their hope is threatened by forest rangers determined to burn down their village to make way for a national park. Beyond the veil of smoke, an abandoned theatre stands hidden in the jungle, haunted by ogre soldiers fleeing the King’s army in an ancient war reflecting the struggle of the villagers.

title: Conversation with the Sea
overview: In Jerusalem, Kamal, a 60-year-old Palestinian man, is ordered by an Israeli court to pay a large social security debt allegedly owed by his son Wael. But Wael drowned in the Red Sea decades ago. When no official record of his death can be found, Kamal follows the only remaining lead to uncover what happened to his son.

title: The Sound of Us Fading
overview: A quiet, introverted teenage boy records small sounds because he seems afraid to forget. When he meets Mara, a mysterious girl that is interested in his strange hobby, he slowly discovers more about Mara and about himself.

title: Le Trident
overview: A young man finds himself at a party stumbling when socializing with three women; a complicated friendship, a chance fling, and a reawakened crush.

title: A Day in the Life of Jo: Chapter Phaedra
overview: Jo, a 15-year-old tomboy, has a nightmare made of fog and aurora light: her dog is lost, her voice cannot be heard, and her surroundings seem completely unfamiliar. Has the tone of the day been set yet?

title: Salón de Belleza
overview: A beauty salon in a city ravaged by a mysterious disease becomes a refuge for the afflicted as they linger between life and death.

title: Racism In A*t
overview: When an organization that hunts prejudice in art finds its next target, silence is no longer an option.

title: Under The Rug
overview: A man hides a dead body in his apartment and he suspects everyone who comes to the door knows what he did.

title: Meteorite
overview: Tefa and Nia live in a small town near the Magdalena River, where they raise Nia's young nephew. Nia persuades Tefa to join her in smuggling cellphones into the regional prison. Their journey leads them through an extravagant amusement park built on the grounds of a drug lord's former estate. As they wander among water slides, verdant paths, and concrete dinosaurs, disquieting memories whisper in the summer heat. In a landscape where violence lingers beneath every surface, Tefa is drawn toward an inevitable encounter.

title: Dust
overview: He wanders around the Comb of the Wind, where the sea rises and breaks against the shore. Along the way, he passes an old Basque farmhouse, a silent man, a woman drinking water, a woman smoking, punks gathered in a rock bar, and people in the ancient city at sunset. The Diamond Sutra speaks of all living beings in these words: "Specks of dust are not specks of dust; therefore, they are called specks of dust".

title: Biff the Human Slayer
overview: A delusional vampire takes it upon himself to rid his town of violence. To do so, he teams up with a couple of freshly turned vampires, a stubborn christian struggling to adjust to his new truth, and a rook who is quick to adapt to hers.

title: Sisters
overview: Twelve-year-old Despina takes her younger sister, Annie, on a journey from the suburbs to the chaotic center of Athens, without explaining why or revealing their final destination.

title: My Cousin’s Wedding
overview: A forgotten wedding videotape holds the coming-of-age story of a girl, pieced together through fragments of family life in provincial Greece during the 2000s. From the wedding festivities before the ceremony to the couple’s exit from the church, childhood memories intertwine with contemporary recordings of her adult self.

title: The Militia
overview: Daniel Pierce dreams of joining the local Militia alongside his father once he turns eighteen, but when his Dad becomes the target of the local Sheriff, Daniel and his friends form their own militia in a troubled effort to save him.

title: Guria
overview: GURIA (its a region in western Georgia) is an astute dramedy about everyday life in a village in western Georgia. This poignant, yet humorous slice of life, brims with charming, loveable characters – fighting against all odds to live a proud and joyful life. Guria champions ingenuity, kindness, and the eternal search for love despite a raging civil war. Though set after the collapse of the Soviet Union, it is a timely reminder of how shared humanity and compassion are the truest measure of our capacity.

title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
overview: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

title: Pressure
overview: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

title: Red Flag
overview: The story follows the pilot Ahmed and his wife, an advertising company manager, highlighting the challenges of love, hesitation, trust, and infidelity in young couples’ relationships.

title: Only the Dead Fish Go with the Flow
overview: Camille is a 6-year-old boy, but Camille feels like a girl. For Carnival, Camille goes to school dressed as a princess despite the school’s refusal to recognize Camille as a girl. The principal summons her mother for a final confrontation.

title: The Fire Within You
overview: Antonio, who fled Naples many years ago, has built a family and a successful career in Milan, far from his mother Angela — a woman excessive in both her virtues and her flaws, irresistible, old-fashioned and hostile like few others — who has come to visit for Christmas and seems determined to stay.  Christmas Eve dinner becomes an emotional battlefield, at once comic and fierce, bringing to the surface a past of impositions and misunderstandings. With a stubborn capon that refuses to end up in the pot, a daughter whose arrival remains uncertain, and an unexpected distinguished guest, the evening turns into a reckoning between mother and son destined to change the meaning of their bond forever: a love that burns like a fire within, one that never dies out — not even by leaving.

title: The Hallowed
overview: The mysterious death of a family patriarch during Holy Week forces his three estranged granddaughters to return to their ancestral home, where their simmering resentments explode just as a vengeful supernatural presence—anchored to a sinister religious statue known as the 13th Apostle—begins to terrorize them, exposing a truth far more terrifying than any ghost.

title: Well Being
overview: Short film written by Emir Kuliev, directed by Kevin McNally.

title: Something Seems Off
overview: A group of three teenage boys decide to go ghost hunting in their friends backyard, and when things go wrong there is nobody they can trust.

title: Something Seems Off
overview: A group of three teenage boys decide to go ghost hunting in their friends backyard, and when things go wrong there is nobody they can trust.

title: Drawn Together
overview: Marfil Cortés, daughter of a Spanish business tycoon, sees her perfect New York life shattered when she’s suddenly kidnapped and mysteriously released. As a result, her father assigns the enigmatic Sebastian Moore as her bodyguard.

title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The RiffTrax Experiments — Sting of Death
overview: The storied history of Mystery Science Theater includes many, MANY cheap rubber monster suits... and somehow, some way, Sting of Death may have the worst so far. MSTies might recognize director William Grefé as the director behind the MST3K Season 2 experiment Wild Rebels. You'll be happy to know he made Sting of Death first, so Wild Rebels was a movie he made as an even more experienced filmmaker. As an added bonus, this movie also features the aptly titled "Do The Jellyfish" by Songwriting Hall of Fame inductee Neil Sedaka. Does this tune warrant TWO extended dance sequences? Probably not, but it is an earworm that will still be drilled into your head long after the credits roll.

title: La Moula
overview: Thanks to Charlie, a cocaine trafficker, and his gangster associates, Jérôme, a struggling organized crime reporter, sees an opportunity to reboot his career. While waiting for a drug shipment near Marseille, the possible presence of a cop puts them all in danger…

title: The Color of the Sun
overview: A raw coming-of-age that asks what it means to belong, to fight, and to grow up among the ghosts of the past.

title: Letters from the Silenced Country
overview: A hybrid documentary portraying contemporary Belarus through the individuals who have endured imprisonment, repression, and exile — voices from a silenced country, suffocated by the regime.

title: Rapunzel
overview: Caíque is bullied because of his long hair, considered girlish by the boys in his neighborhood. Torn between fitting in and being true to himself, he feels compelled to take a radical step.

title: The Plage
overview: Brankec just wants to escape the horros of civilisation and enjoy his time at the beach. However, his retreat turns out to be anything but quiet.

title: Cannibal
overview: A young woman haunted by her past is about to embark on a journey in an attempt to forget and atone for her sins, but she will end up spiraling into a nightmare of terror and tragedy that teaches her there are things one cannot escape.

title: Bunny-Man
overview: A multimillionaire superhero strikes against evil forces in anonymity wearing a rabbit mask. He is driven by the desire to avenge his sister who committed suicide after suffering a violent act, images of which wound up on the internet.

title: Night Shift
overview: A night watchman encounters an unspeakable force while working at an abandoned building. His struggle for survival exposes a dark truth, dragging his sibling Kai into the terrifying events.

title: Suanggi: Ilmu Kutukan
overview: A debt-ridden, former vocalist relocates to his remote Papuan hometown under the pretense of visiting his terminally ill adoptive mother, masking a sinister plot to plunder her estate that inadvertently unleashes a lethal, ancient supernatural entity.

title: Iyus Jenius
overview: Following the tragic loss of his father, a demoralized ten-year-old boy overcomes severe emotional distress and academic decline through the guidance of an whimsical imaginary friend, who helps him reclaim his confidence and intellectual potential.

title: WrestleHer
overview: Women's wrestling is the fastest-growing sport in America. But it's still not fully sanctioned. In Ohio, a wrestling hotbed, girls must compete for their titles - and fight for their sport to be recognized.

title: The Second Assignment
overview: A film student in the midst of a moral crisis struggles to come up with a concept for his next short film.

title: Mandaadi
overview: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

title: River
overview: After being stranded in a boat on a country river, three siblings are stalked by a faceless killer.

title: Monica's Gang: The Movie
overview: Plot TBA. Based on the popular comic book series.

title: Someone Else's Call
overview: The early 2000s. Young Natasha is torn between the pressure of her rational parents, determined to send her to law school, and her dreams of entering the Academy of Arts in St. Petersburg. A new classmate, the gifted musician Igor, helps her believe in herself and take a risk. The young people fall in love. Years later, Natasha and Igor meet by chance at an exhibition of her paintings. This brings them back to memories of their happy times.

title: Stuffed
overview: Araminta, a brooding, dubiously ethical taxidermist, secretly desires to stuff a human specimen. She finds her perfect match in Bernie, a sandwich factory worker whose life is all but memorable. The two decide to go ahead with the plan, but not before they find each other (and various other dead things) in the process.

title: Twist & Shoot: Mister Suzuki
overview: Seijun Suzuki became a cinema legend in the 1960s with a handful of pop-art films. So how can you make a portrait of this iconoclastic director without also adopting a 'style to kill' documentary convention, as well as testimonies from a variety of leading figures in contemporary Japanese and international filmmakers.

title: Maids to Order
overview: A driven entrepreneur establishes a domestic helper agency, navigating the complex and often humorous dynamics of managing her idiosyncratic staff while simultaneously resolving personal crises.

title: Между нами, девочками
overview: Three friends, Naika, Zhenya, and Alisa, embark on a traditional spa weekend to escape their routine and family roles, but especially their mothers-in-law. Their plans are ruined when Naika's future mother-in-law, Margarita Pavlovna, unexpectedly joins them, and the three friends' escape from reality and everyday life turns into a true test of their friendship. It turns out they all view life differently.

title: Mum, I'm Alien Pregnant
overview: When a messy underachiever accidentally gets alien-pregnant, she must overcome skeptical doctors, a useless baby daddy, and her oversharing mum in order to survive and reclaim her life.

title: Trick
overview: Successful illustrator Daniele Mallarico travels to Naples to look after his four-year-old grand-son while his daughter is away for a few days. What begins as a simple babysitting job turns into a subtle psychological duel, as the child’s boundless imagination slowly unsettles him. Trapped together in the apartment, Daniele is forced to confront something far more disturbing than a mischievous child: the fear of aging and the loss of creativity. Through this strange encounter, he may rediscover the power of imagination he thought he had lost.

title: Ratrace
overview: What would you do if you found a bag full of money?

title: Emperor
overview: After taking a deserted Moscow, Napoleon occupies the Kremlin, where his loyal General Michel Clément, a descendant of a Russian boyar who came to Russia believing in the justice of Napoleon's campaign, constantly stands by his side. Meanwhile, the monks of the Chudov Monastery plot to assassinate the emperor by mining the Arsenal, and the young noblewoman Maria, seeking revenge for her dead brother, attempts to shoot Napoleon. The failed assassination attempt brings her into contact with Michel and the Polish officer Józef Sadok. Disguised as an actress in the monastery, Maria finds herself drawn into a dangerous game where rescue, suspicion, and a budding bond with Michel gradually change the fates of all involved.

title: The Apple is Poison
overview: A man finds a mysterious yet threatening note in a bunch of apples.

title: True Love
overview: Elliot wants to reconnect with his ex-boyfriend, Will, but a dark turn reveals the true nature of their relationship.

title: No Way Home
overview: Behind every secret lies a greater lie. When an unknown entity appears, reality begins to fracture as long-hidden truths and an ancient conspiracy collide, revealing a mystery that was never meant to be uncovered.

title: Jangan Lupa Bahagia
overview: Ulla (Alghifahri Jasin) must become the backbone for her two younger siblings, Imma (Jasmin Risach) and Ikbal (M Aqif Difullah), after their parents pass away. They are staying in an empty house owned by their father’s best friend. Ulla is determined to keep her two younger siblings in school to fulfill the dreams of their late parents. To make ends meet, Ulla works hard as an online motorcycle taxi driver. But a setback occurs when her cell phone—her primary tool for work—is severely damaged after falling and being run over by a motorcycle. At the same time, they are forced to leave the house where they’ve been staying because the homeowner’s child has decided to sell it.

title: Angelo Azzurro
overview: Short film directed by Tommaso Acquarone.

title: Silence
overview: After his stand-up routine goes awry, Luka goes to drink his sorrows away in a bar. There he meets a mysterious woman in a bar, with the two immediately hitting it off and deciding to go to the former's apartment together. However, as the night goes on, what was supposed to be a one time hook-up leads to the two discovering much more about themselves and they form a powerful spiritual connection.

title: Bloom
overview: Leo, a shy young florist, knocks on the wrong door during a flower delivery and meets Noah, a charismatic dancer. As their unexpected romantic bond deepens, Leo embarks on a journey toward love, adulthood and self-acceptance.

title: Wolf Ticket
overview: A down on his luck man purchases the secret to success: a ticket that turns the buyer into a werewolf.

title: The Return
overview: Ivan and Ana, a young couple from Belgrade, arrive to Begaljica to sell their grandfather's old house. The rural idyll, as well as meeting a friendly grandma, affects their relationship.

title: The Phantom
overview: Two female producers are commissioned to create a short documentary for an exhibition dedicated to Rubén Santantonín, an elusive figure of the Argentine avant-garde who died very young, in the late 1960s. However, the client imposes one unexpected condition: the video must be made together with David Lamelas, Santantonín’s former collaborator and today an internationally recognized figure of conceptual art. At first, the plan seems clear and limited in scope: Lamelas, accompanied by a young film crew, gathers archival materials, documents the few surviving works, and interviews curators and major artists – such as Luis Felipe Noé and Marta Minujín – who, along with Santantonín and Lamelas, peopled the legendary scene at the Instituto Torcuato Di Tella. Lamelas gradually realizes that reconstructing the story of his friend also means confronting a series of gaps and contradictions.

title: Ground Floor
overview: Follows Kristóf, a man who discovers black mould covering his apartment wall and begins questioning neighbors about leaky pipes, triggering events that turn his world upside down.

title: Be Brave
overview: A documentary film that chronicles the extraordinary personal and entrepreneurial journey of Renzo Rosso, one of the most visionary figures in international fashion and communication. It tells this story by engaging with and utilizing artificial intelligence in a provocative and original way, placing the debate over the boundaries between human creativity and technology—and between the real and the artificial—at the heart of the film.

title: Бүркітші
overview: No description

title: Позывной «Аскет»
overview: A group of saboteurs infiltrates a chemical plant to carry out a terrorist attack. Their cunning plan is thwarted when a former Russian special forces officer with the call sign "Asket" crosses their path.

title: Inferno
overview: Footage of the January 2025 Southern California wildfires is accompanied by narration from biblical passages about Hell from the Greek translation of the Bible, bringing together the antiquity, modernity, reality and fantasy.

title: Rapinoe
overview: Soccer star Megan Rapinoe explores what it means to win and lose in this intimate portrait.

title: Haje
overview: Hoping to settle in Gunsan, filmmaker Hwang Yun encounters the ruined village of Haje in 2018. Nearly every resident has left, but Jeon Jin-hyeon remains, resisting eviction by the Ministry of National Defense. A 600-year-old hackberry tree, another of Haje's last inhabitants, is threatened by expansion of a U.S. military base. Peace activists gather to protect it, and Yun joins them. As dangerous weapons arrive at the base, they hold the monthly Paeng Paeng Cultural Festival, seeing Haje and the tree as a frontline of peace. After more than five years of effort, the tree is designated a national heritage site.

title: Untitled Woman
overview: An elegant, meticulously composed character study set at an art class with a charismatic teacher, middle-aged woman longing to be seen, and a delightful group of eccentrics eager to gaze.

title: White Shirt
overview: The son of businessman Vahram Stepanyan, Mark, runs over a man while intoxicated, an incident that becomes life-changing for all the film’s characters. To help his son avoid punishment, Vahram has Mark admitted to a psychiatric hospital, where he meets Sally, a young woman who has been living there for a long time, and falls in love with her.  Determined to get Sally out of the hospital, Mark orchestrates their escape. The two set out to find Sally’s mother, but the journey proves difficult and is filled with challenging trials.

title: The Sunsets in the West
overview: A folk duo begins to have issues when one of them wants to leave the band and pursue music with their girlfriend instead.

title: Runner
overview: A young runner’s life quickly slips out of control after an accident in which he loses a large quantity of drugs. As he struggles to replace the missing package under intense time pressure, his decisions become increasingly dangerous.

title: LOUTROPOLIS
overview: When the urban regeneration project of the former Ellinikon International Airport of Athens begins right outside his door, Vasos, one of the area’s oldest residents, struggles to adjust to a place that no longer feels like home.

title: Krypto Saves the Day!: Space Busted
overview: Supergirl takes Krypto the Superdog on an adventure into space! Can he save the aliens he meets along the way?

title: The Face of Horror
overview: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

title: The Nation's Gambit
overview: Norway's Prime Minister is kidnapped by a terrorist who makes only one demand. That the politicians in power are playing a game of chess over the Prime Minister's life. Each chess piece represents people who work for the state or leaders in society. If the politicians win the game, the prime minister will live, but every piece lost on the chess boards means the loss of a human life. The politicians and their appointed rescue team, the Delta Squad, are faced with an impossible dilemma: Can they afford to sacrifice human lives in an attempt to save the Prime Minister? With only 24 hours to win the game and save the prime minister, they have no choice but to play the deadly game.

title: De Gaulle: Liberté
overview: Part two of a two-part biopic following French army officer Charles De Gaulle's life and political commitment between 1940 and 1945, and trace his development towards a political career.

title: Trash Mountain
overview: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

title: Practical Magic 2
overview: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

title: Idda
overview: Adele and Sofia, childhood friends now in their thirties, reunite after years apart to fulfill a dream they once shared: reaching the summit of Mount Etna. But something feels off, and a bitter confrontation breaks out, opening old wounds and unveiling deeply buried secrets. They separate just as the volcano begins to tremble. Adele presses on alone, haunted by the wish that she had turned back and reached the crater together with Sofia to listen to the mountain’s magical breathing.

title: Nino – A Film About Nino Rota
overview: An in-depth documentary into the life of renowned Italian composer Nino Rota, who wrote the score for 16 films directed by Federico Fellini, including “La Strada,” “8 1/2,” “Juliet of the Spirits” and “Amarcord,” besides “La Dolce Vita.” He also composed music for Franco Zeffirelli’s “Romeo and Juliet” and the Sicilian-inspired theme for “The Godfather,” whose “Part II” score won him his only Oscar. Rota’s 150 films also included collaborations with King Vidor (“War and Peace”) and Luchino Visconti (“The Leopard”). Rota died at 68 in 1979.

title: Haiwaan
overview: A retired judge faces difficulty keeping his daughter safe from a convict he imprisoned. Later, when he gets murdered, a man with visual impairment who was loyal to him tries to defend his daughter.

title: The Smell of Apples
overview: In the insulated bubble of white Apartheid South Africa, Marnus, a sheltered 11-year old boy accuses the grandson of his family’s domestic worker of steeling his fishing rod. A brutal chain of events is set in motion, shattering the illusion of his family’s wholesome facade.

title: The Death of Time as We Know It
overview: Daisy finds a mysterious amulet which she believes is altering her perception of time.

title: Sunshine Girls
overview: SUNSHINE GIRLS follows the story of Elaine, a timid woman nearing her 30th birthday who must make the difficult choice between motherhood and medically induced photosynthesis.  After prolonged environmental destruction, Elaine’s world is experiencing a dangerous shortage of oxygen.  Science has created a solution to this problem: a “minimally invasive” medical procedure that allows women’s reproductive systems to host photosynthesis and cellular respiration, ultimately enabling them to give birth to air.  For the first time in her life, amongst the ragtag troupe of oxygen-producing misfits called the Sunshine Girls, Elaine finally begins to grow into the woman she has always wanted to be...but not everything is always as bright and sunny as it seems.

title: Glaxo
overview: Chivilcoy, 1957. In a quiet Argentinian town, the arrival of an ominous former police commissioner and his seductive wife fractures the bond between four inseparable young men. Decades later, the past resurfaces, forcing them to confront old wounds, guilt, and the possibility of revenge in a country which has lost its innocence.

title: Girl Group
overview: A pop diva, kicked out of her own group's reunion tour and slapped with a community service court order, seizes the chance to stage a comeback by coaching a group of misfit teen girls for a major record label audition, only to push them too far, forcing her to confront her toxic industry — and her own streak of self-destruction.

title: Big Little Things
overview: A seemingly perfect middle-class Chinese family faces an unprecedented situation when Lei brings a man home on NYE to pretend to be her boyfriend. Her same-sex girlfriend's unexpected visit intertwined her with a real intimacy crisis.

title: Unidentified Murder
overview: Alien Alert!!! An influencer couple staged a harmless prank in pursuit of clicks and likes. Little do they know, their little escapade has gone out of control and spiraled into a real tragedy. A series of accidents, followed by blackmails and Extraterrestrial Encounters somehow echo and unveil the myth of a myterious child disappearnace 25 years ago! A group of five, a chain of bizzare events, layers of schemes and plot twists. It's all-you-can-experience in One Crazy Night!

title: Faith
overview: Gina, a hard-working and devoted single mother, meets a quietly enigmatic stranger, Michael. The presence of someone who appears to care for her brings a new and exciting dynamic to her life, despite the fact she knows nothing about him or what his intentions towards her really are. Is he a friend, a potential lover or something more sinister?

title: This Time, I Mean It
overview: This Time, I Mean It, is a Comedy Drama that follows the story of Sam, who must fight against time to stop his girlfriend from leaving his life forever.

title: Snared
overview: Join us on a journey around Auckland oceans and beaches, uncovering the impacts of fisheries on ocean ecosystems in New Zealand. Discover the balance we need to protect ocean life and appreciate the beauty of our marine life.

title: Tainted Blood
overview: A vampire is overwhelmed by her greed of blood.

title: Lumalalí Garawón
overview: Isiatinu is a young woman passionate about the art of drumming, in a community where this practice is forbidden for women. After facing discrimination, she decides to flee into the wilderness, guided by her ancestral spirits who seem to be calling her.  Throughout her journey—during which she communicates through the distant beats of her own drum—Isiatinu faces challenges that help her gain strength and determination, training until she masters the instrument enough to convince her community of her talent.

title: First Person: A Film About Love
overview: Stifled by her family life and the stranglehold of feminine expectations, a mother who has it all decides to pursue herself above all else and refuses to bend to society’s mores, even in the face of unspeakable tragedy.

title: my father is a tofu
overview: A son visited the tofu factory to see his father, who worked there. As they followed the series of steps in the tofu making process, they shared stories about dreams they had once pursued, fears they had faced, and things they had to let go of to keep life moving forward. From that conversation, the son began to see that his father’s life was no different from the tofu he made every day. Both were born from a long process, endured various pressures, and continued to change shape over time.

title: Sounds from home
overview: When filmmaker Nathan Silver and his wife Nicole Fuentes moved halfway around the world, Nathan’s parents took up birdwatching and began sending them audio recordings from their bird identifying app. It wasn’t so much the birds you can hear on the recordings but discussions about the birds, life in the United States, and aging as a couple. From their new home in France, Nathan and Nicole began pairing these recordings with footage of the birds and life around them.

title: A Brief Encounter
overview: Kath, an Italian-Filipino woman, works remotely as a digital content moderator in Genoa. When she learns that a colleague in the Philippines has taken his own life—crushed by the very job that fills her own days (the endless cataloging of beheadings, torture, live-streamed suicides, and child abuse)—she initially takes two days off, then extends her break, no longer convinced she can bring herself to return to her terminal. A massage appointment introduces her to Jenny, a Filipino woman who tends to people's bodies as a side job. That scheduled hour evolves into something more—an encounter neither woman expected. Each carrying her own burdens and losses, they finally find a way, together, to stop being invisible. The screen, once capable only of wounding them, now reflects a new image: a redemptive possibility for healing.

title: Magazine
overview: A young intern faces intoxicating power dynamics at a prestigious New York City literary magazine.

title: Salvation
overview: A tenacious aspiring guru must go to extreme measures to pay off the debts he’s accrued from trying, and failing, to set up an online life-coaching business in a post-industrial Scottish town.  Exploring the world of male influencer culture and how it might be affecting the young men who come into its orbit, SALVATION blends mounting tension, dark comedy and a forensic focus on its protagonist to explore the very modern story of a delusional life coach spiralling out of control.

title: ​The Haunted Cat and the Unfolding Petroglyph​
Maya Bhanekai Yesto Hola
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: Where Jasmine Blooms
overview: Athina is an employee at an open air cinema, while Anthi is a regular customer. Over the course of a summer, they fall in love little by little, with every different film that is shown.

title: The Cat Is A Wide-Eyed Night
overview: Two brothers' sporadic visits to their death-ridden mother becomes the long-lost road to their unending love for each other.

title: Children of the Valley
overview: After his father voluntarily surrenders to Oplan Tokhang, a newly orphaned prepubescent boy tries to befriend a young, enigmatic shoemaker, forming a transient connection in a decaying shoe factory confronted by its looming shutdown.

title: За чертой
overview: Two spirits meet in the bustle of modern China. Their invisible journey through the metropolis brings the past and the future into conflict. While the spirits debate the value of memory and progress, three artists—a calligrapher, a graffiti artist, and a poet—search for an answer to this same question in the present through their work, building a bridge between tradition and modernity.

title: Wendochu Alteweledum
overview: A Movie By Mubarek Yasin

title: Dream Girl
overview: Mikey tells Eve about the girl she loves, Eve tries to picture her.

title: Smudge the Blades
overview: Treaty 6 Blades, an under-18 hockey team from an Alberta reservation, face their last season together while navigating their tough northern league.

title: The Surgeon
overview: A former surgeon is kidnapped and given an impossible choice.

title: Grunk The Smasher
overview: In an age of grim violence and gore-drenched savagery, a brave warrior embarks on an epic adventure to rescue a beautiful harem girl from the clutches of insidious evil. Journey with Grunk as he braves the Catacombs of Madness, bargains with fiendish witches, and smashes strange and fantastic creatures in his quest to quench his lusty barbarian appetites.

title: Babies
overview: Struggling with the decision of whether or not to bring a child into the world, Annie and her husband Aaron become instant co-parents when their newly-divorced friend moves into their home with her 4-year-old. An ensemble comedy drama about the journey to parenthood... or not.

title: AUFTRAG
overview: A scarred survivor struggles between choices that blur dream and reality, each step pulling him deeper into his own downfall.

title: Geisha War
overview: Rival bosses of Japanese Yakuza and American Mafia fight for control. Blood is shed... like fountains.

title: Evil Genius
overview: Follows the true story of the 2003 death of Brian Wells, a notorious case known as the “collar bomb” or “pizza bomber” incident. The FBI investigation revealed an extraordinarily complex and bizarre plot, later described as one of the most intricate crimes in the Bureau’s history.

title: Ancestors
overview: 1988.  Dreams, memories and history collide as a young man searches for his missing friend.

title: Still Night, Burning House
overview: In her deeply personal debut feature, award-winning filmmaker Carol Nguyen charts her family’s first reunion since her uncle’s mysterious death. Travelling together to Vietnam, the family embarks on a revelatory—and at times uncanny—journey through intergenerational trauma and many-layered loss. With care and probing curiosity, Nguyen guides her loved ones as they navigate unsealed medical records and a decades-long silence, ultimately leading them back to each other. A metaphysical poem for complex mourning, Still Night, Burning House shows how storytelling can transform grief into collective healing.

title: Maternity Leave
overview: Screenwriter Martyna the first-time mother, in her 30s, stops her career for maternity leave, but when a producer takes an interest in her idea, she tries to manage both: the first-time motherhood and her profession dream to become a director. With her hands 24/7 full with a baby she is trying to work at night, also hoping for help from her own mother. The screenwriter feels desperate because she can not rely on her mother for help as she is struggling with her own diagnosis.

title: Little Tragedies
overview: In 2011, Daniel Nolasco moved from his small hometown in the Brazilian countryside to Rio de Janeiro. He went to college. He was the first of a group of queer friends to leave the city. Ten years later, none of the people who made up that group live there anymore; some have died, and those who are alive have moved away. The city is called Catalão, a place that everyone says is too good to live in.

title: Lemonade
overview: Danny, a kind-hearted teen about to age out of the care system is facing adulthood without family or support. After a turbulent childhood and separation from his younger brother, Danny is determined to build a future - but one reckless mistake puts him at risk of prison. As his 18th birthday approaches, Josh - his former social worker and the only adult who ever believed in him - returns, offering guidance when Danny needs it most. With new love, big dreams, and overwhelming challenges, Danny must choose whether to repeat the cycle of his past or fight for the life he deserves.

title: Purgatory
overview: In the early 1980s, 13-year-old Beatrice Gravel's comfortable world—family, school, and church—fractures when her mother moves out to 'self actualize', leaving Beatrice and her younger sister Chloe with their devastated father. As Beatrice doubles down on a plan to 'fix' her family, she barrels through bullies, friendship blowups, a make-out party, and a kleptomaniac babysitter—forcing her to decide who she wants to be when she can’t get what she wants.

title: The Way Through
overview: Italy, 2035. Mansfield, Stendhal and Buzzati are friends and partisans fighting against the regime. Engaged in relays of coded messages hidden in ciphered books, they are forced into a race against time: the fascists are about to take the town of Ovada.

title: The Betrayers
overview: A former Israeli politician and Soviet dissident finds his betrayer at a Crimean resort, sparking a confrontation with past wounds and questions of justice and forgiveness.

title: Terminal
overview: Jorge, a man in his fifties, returns to his mother's house after more than thirty years traveling the world.

title: Under the Same Clouds
overview: On a quiet winter morning, Céline and Pierre, an elderly couple, go about their separate routines, never crossing paths. Their gestures speak of tenderness and a shared life. In the stillness of the snowy forest, they find each other once again.

title: Masc
overview: Robin, a young autistic man desperate to fit in, tries on different roles to understand what kind of man he's supposed to be.

title: Nosotros
overview: Romero, a 23-year-old Indigenous man who used to drive a three-wheeled mototaxi (TucTuc) in his rural town, flees local gang extortion and migrates to Guatemala City. He finds a job as a security guard at a commercial center, where he falls in love with a trans woman who runs a local business. Together, they build an emotional sanctuary, but their bond is quickly threatened by the deep-seated prejudice and hostility of his coworkers.

title: Countryside
overview: Estranged brothers, Sean and Luke, return to their rural childhood home. When a zombie outbreak throws the world into chaos, they have no choice but to confront the sacrifices they are willing to make for family.

title: Falling into Place
overview: Kaia returns home for her town's fall festival as well as her high school reunion and spends the week with her childhood best friend, James, to complete their unfinished fall bucket list.

title: Gail
overview: A superfan of the Canadian band Our Lady Peace follows them on their 30th anniversary tour across Canada.

title: The Episode
overview: A man unravels while watching his girlfriend's steamy guest spot on a hit TV show.

title: Gorilla, Guerrilla
overview: Peru, 1968. Deep in the jungle, a ragtag film crew is stranded without money, morale, or meaning. Three months behind schedule, they must survive a collapsing production and their dangerously paranoid director.

title: The Werefish
overview: A man seeks the help of an expert when their roommate starts acting a bit fishy.

title: Lena Situations - Celui où ils disent au revoir
Designing The Dead, Feared by The Living
overview: Assigned to illustrate a male Indonesian ghost, Nina, a graphic designer, struggles to find references because most Indonesian ghosts are depicted as women. Her search leads to an Indonesian obsession with a woman ghost and news of horrific violence against women.

title: Steamboat Killie
